g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have the existing Kindle app manage PDFs as well. → Open both PDFs and ebooks for school r
eading in one single application instead of across scattered places.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Filter and search previously read material by when it was read, by month or year. → Save v
aluable course PDFs into a personal student library so they stay accessible after the cour
se material is no longer available.
